title: Every pg.query call site inside the facade passes a static string literal as its first argument
asA: reviewer of an rcf-lite Postgres project auditing for SQL injection risk at the driver boundary
iWant: an AST scan over the facade directory to prove every pg.query first argument is a static string literal with $N parameters, per the node-postgres parameterised-queries contract
soThat: a call site that concatenates or template-literal-interpolates consumer values into SQL text is caught at build time before it ships

acceptanceCriteria.description: An AST scan over every .ts/.js/.mjs file under the applied fixture's facade directory finds every call to pg.query and asserts each first-argument node is a StringLiteral (Literal node with a string value), not a TemplateLiteral, not a BinaryExpression whose operator is '+' with a string operand. Parameters are supplied as an array whose values bind to $1, $2, ... $N placeholders in the string.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the applied fixture's src/store.mjs and any sibling module inside the facade directory
acceptanceCriteria.when: a Node built-in AST parser walks every call expression whose callee is 'pg.query' or resolves to a method named 'query' on a pg.Client, pg.Pool, or pg.PoolClient reference
acceptanceCriteria.then: every first-argument node is a Literal with typeof value === 'string'; no first-argument node is a TemplateLiteral or a string-concatenation expression
